capabilities: move completed checkbox tasks to the bottom of their list
sort nested sub-tasks recursively at each indentation level
re-sort automatically while editing in Live Preview and in Reading Mode
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a build/architecture section for developers but no usage instructions or screenshots.
problem: Completed tasks stay interleaved with open ones in Obsidian lists, so users must manually reorder or visually hunt for what remains.
summary: Task auto-sorter that moves completed Markdown checkbox tasks to the bottom of their list, including nested sub-tasks.
